Before adding devices during commissioning process, ensure QR code for the Zone is saved on commissioning device and provided to jobsite manager/primary contact as backup. QR codes cannot be retrieved if lost. If QR code is lost, manual reset of devices currently assigned under that QR code will be required for further commissioning. If abandoning a commissioning process that is underway, please first “Delete” the devices in the “Lights” menu first, so the lights can be properly added for the next commissioning attempt.
